name: hamlet-trio-scripted
brief: Three neighbours meet in the pond hall and each gives one short talk, one at a time.

seats.character: Ada is cheerful and keeps bees.

do: Hello everyone, I am Ada, and I love how the apple trees in the orchard catch the morning light.

seats.character: Bo is shy and plays music.

do: Change of plan from me: I want to tell you all about the old piano in the pond hall, which still plays every key.
Hello, I am Bo, and I want to tell you how quiet and still the pond is just before sunset.

rules.match: now and wait there with everyone|Walk there now|Go back there now

seats.character: Cy is curious and asks many questions.

do: Hi all, I am Cy, and I keep wondering who first built the little cottage at the edge of the hamlet.
